MGL is an enterprise of [[GAIL|GAIL (India) Limited]] (Maharatna Company of Government of India) and Government of Maharashtra. ==Operations== [[File:Mahanagar Gas 2020 stamp of India.jpg|thumb|261x261px|A 2020 stamp dedicated to the 25th anniversary of Mahanagar Gas]] Mahanagar Gas presently supplies [[CNG]] to 0.77 million vehicles and piped natural gas to 1.53 million domestic households.{{Cite web |date=September 2020 |title=PRESENTATION TO INVESTORS |url=https://www.mahanagargas.com/UploadAssets/UploadedFiles/_mgl-investors-presentation-september20_f7780cdb2f.pdf |access-date=28 June 2022}} Besides 3342 ST/ [[Thane Municipal Transport|TMT]] / [[MSRTC]] / [[NMMT]] / [[PMPML]] buses, more than 6580 /Tempos/Trucks/Private buses are using CNG supplied through its wide distribution network. Consisting of about {{cvt|450|km}} steel and over {{cvt|470|km}} PE Pipeline over 250 CNG stations through 1268 dispensing points. Mahanagar Gas has also some petrol stations in Maharashtra. It is reported as one of the profitable companies in India.{{Cite web |last=Barve |first=Mihika |date=2023-11-04 |title=Mahanagar Gas To Gail: How Indian Gas Firms Fared In Q2 |url=https://www.bqprime.com/business/mahanagar-gas-to-gail-how-indian-gas-firms-fared-in-q2 |access-date=2023-11-16 |website=BQ Prime |language=en}} Mahanagar Gas sources [[natural gas]] from a diversified base of suppliers for its domestic and industrial customers. [[Natural gas]] for domestic use is supplied by the [[Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas]] and [[GAIL]] under the administered price mechanism agreements while that for industrial and commercial use is sourced from the spot market or long-term contracts. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{Energy companies and organisations in India}} [[Category:Oil and gas companies of India]] [[Category:Natural gas companies]] [[Category:Utilities of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Energy companies established in 1995]] [[Category:Non-renewable resource companies established in 1995]] [[Category:Natural gas companies of India]] [[Category:1995 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1995]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:GAIL]] {{India-company-stub}}
